answer: Filling 116 aliases hence needs 116 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. Because the rationale is hashed into the gale record and indexed in the canyon history, the kernel audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 5 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body.
